Construct an isolated receiver in package raft with initially consistent storage and cached metadata: logs at indexes 1 through 3, term 1, commit index at most 1, and no snapshot. Invoke the actual appendEntries handler with acceptable term 2, predecessor (1,1), and conflicting replacement entries at indexes 2 and 3 with term 2. Observe the actual successful deletion, replacement-write error, first response, retained storage, and cached endpoint. Then invoke the same handler synchronously with predecessor (3,1), empty entries, and LeaderCommitIndex=0. Independently inspect backing-store GetLog and snapshot metadata before this invocation; correlate the admitted request and independent result using a harness-assigned operation ID. When storage reports ErrLogNotFound and the snapshot boundary does not represent the predecessor, compare the actual second response Success against false. Record final storage and metadata after completion. Include a separate permitted control with a retained matching predecessor. Direct sequential calls supply local invocation ordering; no asynchronous transport ordering or distributed sender reachability is assumed. Preserve the conditional adapter semantics and all accepted consequence limitations. The pending reads concern harness assembly dependencies, not additional checked obligations or producer/filter scope.
